scope.stateBefore: Shipment valid; pickup not yet accepted; freight may not be ready.
scope.stateAfter: Pickup ACCEPTED, CONDITIONAL, REJECTED or CANCELLED.

decisionSemantics.decision: Can the carrier/service accept requested location, window, quantity and freight readiness?
decisionSemantics.rule: Valid identity, serviceability, pickup window, cargo readiness and condition-specific prerequisites required.
decisionSemantics.control: Request/response correlation, idempotency, change/cancel reason and stale-version rejection.
decisionSemantics.evidence: Pickup request, acknowledgement/status, appointment and change history.

actions.action: Schedule, update/reschedule or cancel pickup and publish response.

outcomes.outcome: Executable pickup commitment synchronized with shipper and carrier.

bindingNeeds.reason: Canonical generic semantics require client-specific master/contract values before executable projection.
